carousel.title: AFRI DIVAZ
carousel.description: Four teenage girls with big fashion dreams land the opportunity of a lifetime: a 7-day elite fashion showcase hosted by legendary mogul Tara Obeng. But behind the glamour, runway lights, and designer dreams lies fierce rivalry, sabotage, secrets, and the harsh truth about the fashion industry. Can Afridivaz survive the competition without losing themselves.....or each other?

carousel.title: CITY HERO
carousel.description: Soma is a ten-year-old Nigerian boy — asthmatic, bullied, and easy to overlook — until a mysterious device called the Activian, hidden inside a birthday gift, bonds with him and unlocks powers that make him a target for forces far darker than any school yard bully. In a world where extraordinary power hides inside ordinary things, this is the story of a boy who was told he was nothing — and a device that disagreed.

carousel.title: Celestial Eyes
carousel.description: Follow Onwanuju, an occult detective with a full blue moon in her eyes, and Odi Maria, her adventurous best friend as they investigate the mysterious cases that plague their city.

carousel.title: Primordials
carousel.description: in Primordial Red Sun Rising, Governor T’Awub Ka’Andar and his entourage journey to the warrior city of Sizini to seek King Dhinga II's counsel on a mysterious threat. Tensions rise as the king’s shaman reveals ominous visions of darkness, fire, and an approaching danger tethered to a distant star.

carousel.title: Soul Air
carousel.description: A group of tattooed individuals known as soul heirs

carousel.title: OMIMI
carousel.description: A story of an igbo girl looking to change her world

carousel.title: WIDOW'S GUILT
carousel.description: Kim was a wife and a soon to be mother until life took the heart she called home away from her.

carousel.title: No Lifers Game
carousel.description: A game of life and death, only the strong will make it out alive

carousel.title: 4 The Tribe
carousel.description: In a world ruled by spirit power and the five noble tribes that control it, the very fabric of society threatens to come undone, when a hidden power, once thought to be long lost is revived by a sect of dangerous dissidents. Will Maru manage to unite his friends into a powerful new tribe in time to battle the chaos, or will calamity reign on the African continent?

carousel.title: BLACK STAR
carousel.description: A small mercenary crew led by a hard-edged Captain infiltrates warlord Salim’s outpost to steal an obscure black box for the Rabb; the raid succeeds at first but unearths a military-grade chip that sparks a violent counterattack — ending with the wounded young operative Shaibu washed out by an explosion and carried away by a monstrous gorilla, leaving the mission — and his fate — in doubt.

popular_by_toon_central.title: Cross Frequency
popular_by_toon_central.description:
In Blacktower City—the city that never wakes up—Jeikku’s just drifting. Hoverboard under his feet, conspiracy theories on his mind, and dodging anything that smells like responsibility.
But when a sudden Sonic Boom attack rocks the city and his sister Nirukka disappears, the game changes.
Searching for answers, Jeikku dives into the Fringes—where the city’s outcasts flip scrap tech and underground beats into weapons of rebellion. Here he discovers Nightbreaking: rebel crews pushing back against the Thousandth, a shadow figure twisting the city’s people through mind-warping sound frequencies.
Now, with danger around every corner and betrayal lurking in the noise, Jeikku has to decide—will he keep drifting through the chaos, or rise up and become the spark that could set the city free?
Cross Frequency is a manga about rebellion, rhythm, and raw humanity—a high-voltage story where freedom is always one beat away from being silenced.

Amidst a whirlwind of clumsy encounters, heartfelt moments, and comedic misunderstandings, they discover that love isn’t about perfection but embracing each other's quirks and differences.

popular_by_toon_central.title: SENATOR
popular_by_toon_central.description: In an elite Nigerian school, Kosachi Dinta, a top secret agent known as “Senator,” loses his memories during a covert mission and becomes a weak, bullied student unaware of his true identity. Taken in by his manager Temi and befriended by Nemdi and her martial-artist friends, he slowly regains fragments of his deadly past while growing stronger. As The Syndicate closes in, Dinta must uncover who he truly is and protect those he’s come to care for before his forgotten world consumes him.
